name: Cheesy Chickpea "Crisps" with Sesame Seeds & Herbs

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Drain and rinse chickpeas, then pat dry with a clean towel or paper towels. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, sesame seeds, and spices, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (15 oz) can garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp sesame seeds
1 tsp parsley flakes
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
¼ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp smoked paprika

instructions.primary_message: Transfer chickpeas to the baking sheet, spreading them out in a single layer (make sure the chickpeas are touching with no gaps). Evenly sprinkle cheese over top.

Place baking sheet in the preheated oven and bake until chickpeas are golden brown and cheese is melted, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool, 5 minutes (the chickpeas will firm up as they cool). Leave the oven on.

Transfer baked chickpeas to a cutting board, cut into "chips" using a knife, then return to the baking sheet. Place chips back in the oven and continue to bake until they are crisp, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and transfer to a rack to cool, 10 minutes (they will firm up as they cool).
Transfer chickpea chips to a serving platter and enjoy!
